svg.text: 8 long requests where the file the task needs sits behind a run of large files it does not need. A per-slot budget spends itself

svg.text: on the newest and drops the one that matters; one joint budget over the whole request does not.

svg.text: this is why the shipping arm is the compiler. A slot that saves more tokens than it is allowed to is not a saving, it is a failure.
